name: Sulphur
source: A Sulphur type monster girl. Sulphur type monster girls are warriors and this Sulphur is incredibly confident of her abilities. She thinks combat with [url=http://vndb.org/c10474]Leo[/url] is beneath her and it takes considerable effort for Leo to convince her to fight him.
